cues.text: The final check is the last look before the customer sees the garment. Take ten seconds for every piece.
Is the stain still there? Send it back for re-spotting. If it really cannot come out, tell a manager. They can send the customer a Do Over text.
Check the pressing. Pants get one sharp crease, not two. Collars are smooth. No shiny marks.
Check every button. All there, none cracked. Note any broken ones.
Snip loose threads, and use a lint roller on dark clothes.
Turn anything inside out right side out. Make sure sleeves hang straight.
It should smell clean. An odd smell means it goes back to cleaning.
The rule is simple: if it is not right, it does not get bagged. Fix it now, not after the customer complains.
